content: Types and Values in ARMQL While ARMQL is not statically typed, the following types are distinguished at run-time: • Floating-point Numbers (e.g. 1.415e-10 , always 64bit) • Integer Numbers (e.g. -37 , arbitrary length, BigInteger) • Boolean Values (e.g. true or false ) • Strings (e.g. "this is a string" ) • Functions (e.g. x.y.y+x ) • Opaque Objects (e.g. ECV , used enrich the language by abstract data types) • Lists (e.g. [1 ; 4] ); • Undefined (e.g. 1 = 0 , two undefined values are considered to never be equal)
